claims.quote: the Scottish Government is one of the most centralised devolved administrations in Europe
claims.statement: The Scottish Government is one of the most centralised devolved administrations in Europe.

claims.quote: with Holyrood not giving people who know their areas best enough of a say
claims.statement: Holyrood does not give people who know their areas best enough of a say.

claims.quote: the next stage of devolution should place more decision-making in the hands of Scotland’s regions and cities to drive reindustrialisation
claims.statement: The next stage of devolution should place more decision-making in the hands of Scotland's regions and cities to drive reindustrialisation.

claims.quote: Through No10 North, we are rewiring the state
claims.statement: Through No10 North, the UK Government is rewiring the state.

claims.quote: With us working together, there is no limit to what we can achieve for the Scottish people.
claims.statement: If the UK and Scottish Governments work together, there is no limit to what they can achieve for the Scottish people.

claims.quote: power was never supposed to stop at the doors of the Scottish Parliament
claims.statement: Power was never supposed to stop at the doors of the Scottish Parliament.

claims.quote: People in North Lanarkshire, in Fife or in the Highlands know what their communities need better than any minister
claims.statement: People in North Lanarkshire, Fife and the Highlands know what their communities need better than any minister.

claims.quote: The Prime Minister’s offer to the Scottish Government is a genuine one
claims.statement: The Prime Minister's offer to the Scottish Government is genuine.

claims.quote: the Scotland Office is ready to roll up its sleeves alongside them to make it happen
claims.statement: The Scotland Office is ready to work alongside the Scottish Government to make the offer happen.

claims.quote: Two governments, one goal - good jobs and real opportunity in every corner of Scotland.
claims.statement: The UK and Scottish Governments share one goal: good jobs and real opportunity in every corner of Scotland.

facts.quote: after speaking with young people today in Lanarkshire
facts.statement: Andy Burnham spoke with young people in Lanarkshire.

facts.quote: I told the First Minister that I wanted to work with him
facts.statement: Andy Burnham told the First Minister during his first week in office that he wanted to work with him.

facts.quote: This is me making an offer to the Scottish Government.
facts.statement: Andy Burnham made an offer to the Scottish Government to work together.

facts.quote: The Scottish Secretary, Douglas Alexander said:
facts.statement: Douglas Alexander, the Scottish Secretary, made a statement on Scottish devolution and regional empowerment.
